name: oh-finish-callback
description: POST a notification to your own URL when a conversation reaches a terminal state, using a Stop hook. Lets you react immediately instead of only polling. The callback URL/token/payload come from conversation secrets — no customer info is baked into the plugin.

examples.title: Notify on finish
examples.expected_behavior: When the agent finishes, the Stop hook POSTs a small JSON envelope to OH_CALLBACK_URL.
